data.title: KKR Real Estate Finance Trust Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.10 Per Share of Common Stock
data.description: In New York, KKR Real Estate Finance Trust Inc. (NYSE: KREF) declared a dividend of $0.10 per share for the third quarter of 2026. The dividend will be paid on October 15, 2026, to common stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026. KREF is a real estate finance company specializing in senior loan origination and acquisition.

data.title: American Healthcare REIT Declares Third Quarter 2026 Distribution
data.description: In Irvine, California, it was reported that American Healthcare REIT, Inc. (NYSE: AHR) revealed a quarterly distribution of $0.25 per share for the period ending September 30, 2026. This distribution is set to be paid in cash around October 16, 2026, to shareholders on record of its common stock by the end of business on September 30, 2026. American Healthcare REIT, Inc. is a real estate investment trust listed on the NYSE under the symbol AHR.

data.title: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust Releases Q2-2026 Penney Intermediate Holdings LLC Financial Statements and Master Lease Store Performance Disclosures
data.description: In Jersey City, New Jersey, the Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust has submitted a Form 8-K showcasing the Q2-2026 consolidated financial reports of Penney Intermediate Holdings LLC for the periods ending August 1, 2026, and August 2, 2025. This filing also includes detailed disclosures about the performance of Master Lease stores. For further details, interested parties can access the Trust’s Monthly and Quarterly Reports, along with various filings made to the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC").

data.title: Mesa Royalty Trust Announces There Will Be No Distribution for September 2026
data.description: In Houston, Mesa Royalty Trust (NYSE: MTR) released news that there will be no distribution payout for September 2026. This decision comes as the costs and expenses linked to the Trust's royalty properties surpassed the revenue generated from selling oil, natural gas, and other hydrocarbons by the working interest owners. The Trust, designed to hold an overriding royalty interest, faced financial constraints due to this imbalance, leading to the halt in distributions.

data.title: VerifyMe Declares Special Dividend
data.description: In Lake Mary, Florida, VerifyMe, Inc. (NASDAQ: VRME), a company specializing in authentication and precision logistics technologies, recently declared a special cash dividend of $0.15 per share. The dividend is authorized by the Board of Directors and will be distributed pro-rata to shareholders of the company's common stock ($0.001 par value per share) and holders of the Series B Convertible Preferred Stock ($0 value). This dividend marks a significant event for VerifyMe's investors as it provides them with a return on their investment in the company.

data.description: A recent report revealed that the global unemployment rate rose to 6.5% in the last quarter, marking an increase of 1.2% compared to the previous period. The number of unemployed individuals worldwide reached 220 million, with 40% of them being long-term unemployed. Additionally, youth unemployment stood at 13.6%, affecting 73 million young people. The report also highlighted that women were disproportionately impacted by job losses during this period. Notably, the Asia-Pacific region experienced the largest increase in unemployment rates, reaching 5.9%. These figures underscore the significant economic challenges faced by individuals worldwide due to the ongoing effects of the pandemic.
